text.p: Tropical Cyclone Josie will be a significant risk to shipping in the Mozambique Channel during the next 48 hours. Top winds are now 55 mph but they may reach 75 mph in 24 hours. The system will move southward from waters just off the west coast of Madagascar to near the southeast coast of Mozambique during this period. Coastal areas of these countries will likely continue to see beach erosion due to rough surf and high waves.

Tropical Cyclone Gillian is expected to make landfall north of Townsville, Queensland, Australia witin the next 12 hours. Top winds at the time of landfall should be about 40 mph. Coastal areas can expect some damage due to winds and a storm surge. Inland areas should see heavy rain and flash flooding leading to possible mudslides.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
